items.title: Thinking Outside The Box: Digital Design In The AI Era
items.excerpt: A case study in designing AI interaction beyond the text box: how MacPaw built Eney, a character-based AI assistant that prioritizes humanization and personal connection over the default chat prompt. The piece argues human designers remain essential in the AI era and that interface craft, not just model output, is where creative differentiation lives.

items.title: I Design Products. Then I Make Them. There Is No Handoff.
items.excerpt: Designer Merav Shaked describes rebuilding her portfolio in a single evening by directing AI as a tool rather than delegating to it, collapsing the designer-to-developer handoff entirely. A first-person account of how agentic AI lets one designer own vision through execution, keeping creative control while eliminating the traditional spec-and-throw-over-the-wall workflow.

items.title: Google thinks maths proves its AI is genuinely creative… but is it?
items.excerpt: Google argues that because a diffusion model's score function never perfectly reproduces its training data, image generators are performing genuine creativity rather than memorization. Creative Bloq weighs the claim for designers and artists: is interpolation between learned patterns real creativity, or a mathematical rebrand of remixing? A craft-and-capability read on what 'AI creativity' actually means for creative work.

items.title: Otoy releases OctaneRender 2027.1 in alpha
items.excerpt: Otoy's next major OctaneRender release adds a new neural-rendering mode that builds on its neural radiance cache to deliver near noise-free interactive rendering at low sample counts (DLSS-like), plus an updated AI Light 2.0 for multi-light scenes. A concrete example of machine learning reshaping the day-to-day rendering and look-dev workflow for designers and 3D artists.
